name: Hwei
notes: Opens with Spiraling Despair (R) at t=0, then immediately toggles Serenity and casts Stirring Lights (WE) so its empower is ready for the opening exchanges.

Subject: Disaster (Q) always resolves as Severing Bolt (QW): against a lone stationary dummy it always counts as isolated, so its large missing-health damage multiplier is taken every cast; QQ and QE are never cast because QW deals more against a single target.

Subject: Torment (E) always resolves as Grim Visage (EQ): it has no extra travel/setup delay beyond the standard cast lockout, landing faster than Gaze of the Abyss or Crushing Maw for the same base damage and AP ratio, so EW and EE are never cast.

Subject: Serenity (W) is only ever cast as Stirring Lights (WE); Fleeting Current and Pool of Reflection deal no damage so they are never used, and Wash Brush is never used since it forfeits a cast for no damage.

Signature of the Visionary (passive): every damaging Q/E/R hit marks the dummy for 4s; the next hit from a DIFFERENT one of R/Q/E consumes that mark for the bonus explosion (after its 0.85s delay). Consecutive damage instances from the same ability (e.g. Spiraling Despair's own DoT ticks) never detonate their own mark, matching the rule that a cast cannot consume the mark it itself just applied.

Stirring Lights' bonus magic damage is spent on the next 3 basic attacks or Q/E landing hits within 9s of casting; it is not applied to Spiraling Despair's DoT ticks or explosion, treated here as part of R's single continuous cast rather than separate empowerable hits (an assumption, since the wiki text does not specify this edge case).
Severing Bolt's damage lands 1s after the start of its cast, and its isolation/missing-health multiplier is evaluated against the dummy's health at that landing moment.
Spiraling Despair (R) is only cast once at the opener: even at rank 3 its 80s cooldown is far longer than any fight window modeled, so it never comes off cooldown again inside the fight.
The E slot's cooldown is disputed between sources (wiki tooltip 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s vs. the raw data sheet's 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s); the wiki's displayed tooltip value is used here.
The passive's per-level magic damage bonus uses the wiki's evenly-interpolated 40-to-285 table rather than the data sheet's slightly nonlinear byLevel curve, since that is what is shown to players.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16 given Hwei's mana pool and Stirring Lights' mana restore.
